name: Bug Reports
description: Receives problem reports from the sites that upgrade from this one: files each report, groups the same error across sites, checks that the sender is a Joinery site, and shows the reports to administrators. Install it on an upgrade source only.
author: System Developer

settings.name: bug_reports_rate_limit_requests
settings.label: Reports accepted per hour from one address
settings.helptext: A sender over this many reports in an hour is refused until the hour passes. Reports from one site all come from its address.

settings.name: bug_reports_notify_email
settings.label: Email about new problems
settings.helptext: When set, one email a day for each error not seen in the last day, naming the site, version and where the error is. Empty sends none.

settings.name: bug_reports_retention_days
settings.label: Days to keep closed reports
settings.helptext: Closed reports older than this are deleted with their images by the daily retention sweep. Open reports are kept. 0 keeps closed reports indefinitely.
